General.Name: Oberoi Realty Limited
General.Description: Oberoi Realty Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development business in India. It operates through the Real Estate and the Hospitality segment. The company develops and sells residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, and social infrastructure projects. It also leases commercial properties; and owns and operates a hotel. In addition, the company engages in the sale of rooms, food and beverages, and allied services related to hotel operations, as well as in the provision of property management services. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
